incidents.summary: HSE served Porvair Sciences Limited an improvement notice for failing to ensure employees using tight-fitting respiratory protection against isocyanates were face-fit tested, and recorded the notice as complied with.

sources.title: Notices served - Enforcement notices public
sources.quote: Notice 314939120 served against Porvair Sciences Limited on 19/03/2025

sources.title: Notices served - Enforcement notices public
sources.quote: failure to ensure that employees provided with tight-fitting respiratory protective equipment to control their exposure to substances hazardous to health, namely isocyanates, have been face-fit tested by a competent person to ensure the equipment is suitable to prevent their exposure.
